text: Nag slid into the bathroom. <break time="0.8s" /> And coiled himself. <break time="0.8s" /> Around the big water jar. <break time="0.8s" /> He planned to wait there. <break time="0.8s" /> Until the big man came. <break time="0.8s" /> In the morning. <break time="0.8s" /> After an hour. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki jumped. <break time="0.8s" /> And caught Nags head. <break time="0.8s" /> In his teeth. <break time="0.8s" /> Nag swung him around the room. <break time="0.8s" /> Like a dog shaking a rat. <break time="0.8s" /> But Rikki held on. <break time="0.8s" /> The noise woke the big man. <break time="0.8s" /> Who ran in with his gun. <break time="0.8s" /> And fired. <break time="0.8s" /> It is the mongoose again, Alice. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> The little chap. <break time="0.8s" /> Has saved our lives now. <break time="0.8s" /> The next morning. <break time="0.8s" /> Darzee sang happily. <break time="0.8s" /> About Nags death. <break time="0.8s" /> But Rikki still had work to do. <break time="0.8s" /> Where are Nagainas eggs. <break time="0.8s" /> Asked Rikki. <break time="0.8s" /> In the melon bed. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Darzee. <break time="0.8s" /> Darzees wife. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was smarter than her husband. <break time="0.8s" /> Flew to Nagaina and cried. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh, my wing is broken. <break time="0.8s" /> While Nagaina chased the bird. <break time="0.8s" /> Rikki ran to the melon bed. <break time="0.8s" /> And found twenty five eggs. <break time="0.8s" /> He broke the eggs one by one. <break time="0.8s" /> Until only three were left. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Darzees wife screamed. <break time="0.8s" /> Nagaina has gone onto the veranda. <break time="0.8s" /> And she means killing.
